scope: Corollary 1.2 of the manuscript “The Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three” (preprints/The-Kervaire-Invariant-Problem-at-the-Prime-Three-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 309 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4b9f1ff903605ffa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: (i) There are homotopy equivalences of H-spaces ΩS163 {3} ≃ T163 (3) × ΩT487 (3), BW81 ≃ ΩT487 (3). Consequently, W81 ≃ Ω2T487(3). (ii) For every integer n > 1, the underlying space ΩS2n+1{3} has a nontrivial product decom- position if and only if n ∈ {3, 27, 81}. For every other n > 1 it is mod-three atomic, hence indecomposable. Here a product is nontrivial when both factors are noncontractible. (iii) For every integer n > 1, the homotopy type T2n+1(3) admits a homotopy-associative H-space multiplication if and only if n ∈ {3, 27, 81}. The multiplication on T163(3) supplied by the displayed product is homotopy associative and homotopy commutative. For this multiplication, the third-power map on T163(3) is null-homotopic, as is the third-power map on the loop H-space ΩT487(3).
